title: (2nd LD) Seoul stocks drop for 4th day amid lingering AI woes
caption:
The KOSPI sank past the 5,000 threshold as overseas funds offloaded major chipmakers like Samsung and SK hynix. A combination of new export restrictions on American server hardware and executive shifts at Nvidia rattled tech investors worldwide. Meanwhile, local government bond yields dipped as traders shifted capital toward lower-risk assets.
